question: Calculate: \(1\div4=?\) (Answer as a decimal.)
solution: When the whole is divided into 4 equal parts, each part is \(1/4\). To write this as a decimal, split the whole into 100 equal pieces, called hundredths. Each quarter contains \(100\div4=25\) hundredths, so \(1\div4=0.25\).
